st-mh-gram-panchayats.name: Gram Panchayats of Maharashtra
st-mh-gram-panchayats.description: The village-level tier of Panchayati Raj Institutions in Maharashtra, directly elected under Part IX of the Constitution.
st-mh-gram-panchayats.legalBasis: Constitution of India, Part IX (73rd Amendment, 1992)
st-mh-gram-panchayats.notes: State-wise seat/panchayat count could not be sourced in this research pass: lgdirectory.gov.in's per-state query reports (globalViewStatewiseLocalBody.do and the Download Directory PRI reports) require solving a CAPTCHA to retrieve data, which is outside permitted tooling; only the LGD homepage's national totals (see Local Government of India (aggregate)) were accessible without one. No alternate state-wise secondary source was found before the session's web-search budget was exhausted.

st-mh-panchayat-samitis.name: Panchayat Samitis of Maharashtra
st-mh-panchayat-samitis.description: The intermediate (block) tier of Panchayati Raj Institutions in Maharashtra, directly elected under Part IX of the Constitution.
st-mh-panchayat-samitis.legalBasis: Constitution of India, Part IX (73rd Amendment, 1992)
st-mh-panchayat-samitis.notes: State-wise count not sourced; see st-<code>-gram-panchayats notes for why (LGD per-state reports are CAPTCHA-gated).

st-mh-zila-parishads.name: Zila Parishads of Maharashtra
st-mh-zila-parishads.description: The district-level tier of Panchayati Raj Institutions in Maharashtra, directly elected under Part IX of the Constitution.
st-mh-zila-parishads.legalBasis: Constitution of India, Part IX (73rd Amendment, 1992)
st-mh-zila-parishads.notes: State-wise count not sourced; see st-<code>-gram-panchayats notes for why (LGD per-state reports are CAPTCHA-gated). Typically one Zila Parishad per district, so the count should be close to (but need not exactly equal) the district count.

st-mh-urban-local-bodies.name: Urban Local Bodies of Maharashtra
st-mh-urban-local-bodies.description: The urban local self-government bodies of Maharashtra (municipal corporations, municipalities/municipal councils and nagar/town panchayats), constituted under Part IXA of the Constitution.
st-mh-urban-local-bodies.legalBasis: Constitution of India, Part IXA (74th Amendment, 1992)
st-mh-urban-local-bodies.notes: Only the municipal-corporation count is directly sourced (Wikipedia 'List of municipal corporations in India', cross-validated against the national total of 273 on lgdirectory.gov.in's dashboard). Municipality/nagar-panchayat (municipal council / nagar panchayat) counts per state were not obtainable without the CAPTCHA-gated LGD per-state reports or an additional secondary source, and are left out rather than estimated.

st-mh-assembly.name: Maharashtra Legislative Assembly
st-mh-assembly.description: The lower and directly-elected house of the Maharashtra state legislature.
st-mh-assembly.head: st-mh-pos-speaker

st-mh-legislative-council.name: Maharashtra Legislative Council
st-mh-legislative-council.description: The upper, permanent (non-dissoluble) house of the Maharashtra legislature; 66 members elected (by MLAs, local authorities, teachers' and graduates' constituencies) and 12 nominated by the Governor, one-third retiring every two years.
st-mh-legislative-council.head: st-mh-pos-chairman-legislative-council

holder.notes: By-election due to the resignation of Rajesh Vitekar

st-mh-dept-general-administration.name: General Administration Department
st-mh-dept-general-administration.description: Runs the state secretariat's own administration, protocol, appointments and postings of IAS officers, and Maharashtra Bhavans outside the state.
st-mh-dept-general-administration.head: st-mh-pos-chief-minister

st-mh-dept-home.name: Home Department
st-mh-dept-home.description: Runs the state police, prisons, fire services and internal security; issues arms licences and controls the excise-linked law and order machinery. Held by the Chief Minister, with junior ministers overseeing rural and urban wings.
st-mh-dept-home.head: st-mh-pos-chief-minister
st-mh-dept-home.notes: MoS Pankaj Bhoyar (Minister of State, Government of Maharashtra) holds the Home (Rural) wing and MoS Yogesh Kadam (Minister of State, Government of Maharashtra) the Home (Urban) wing under the CM.

st-mh-dept-law-and-judiciary.name: Law and Judiciary Department
st-mh-dept-law-and-judiciary.description: Drafts and vets state legislation, represents the government in courts and administers the legal affairs, judicial and legislative wings of the secretariat.
st-mh-dept-law-and-judiciary.head: st-mh-pos-chief-minister

st-mh-dept-information-and-public-relati.name: Information and Public Relations Department
st-mh-dept-information-and-public-relati.description: The state's official press and publicity arm; runs government advertising, the Directorate of Information and Public Relations, and state media accreditation.
st-mh-dept-information-and-public-relati.head: st-mh-pos-chief-minister

st-mh-dept-energy.name: Energy Department
st-mh-dept-energy.description: Oversees state power generation, transmission and distribution utilities (Mahavitaran, Mahanirmiti, Mahatransco) and electricity tariff/subsidy policy, excluding new and renewable energy.
st-mh-dept-energy.head: st-mh-pos-chief-minister

st-mh-dept-urban-development.name: Urban Development Department
st-mh-dept-urban-development.description: Frames urban planning, municipal governance and city infrastructure policy for Maharashtra's municipal corporations and councils, including schemes like PMAY (urban) and metro/smart-city projects.
st-mh-dept-urban-development.head: st-mh-pos-deputy-cm-1

st-mh-dept-housing.name: Housing Department
st-mh-dept-housing.description: Runs the state's public housing programmes and regulates housing boards and MHADA, building affordable homes and redeveloping slums and old buildings.
st-mh-dept-housing.head: st-mh-pos-deputy-cm-1

st-mh-dept-public-works.name: Public Works Department
st-mh-dept-public-works.description: Builds and maintains state highways, government buildings and bridges. The MoS-35/38 wing tied to Public Undertakings is a separate charge held by Deputy CM Eknath Shinde.
st-mh-dept-public-works.head: st-mh-pos-minister-20
st-mh-dept-public-works.notes: Portfolio split: Shivendra Raje Bhosale (Cabinet Minister, Government of Maharashtra) holds PWD excluding Public Undertakings (the larger roads/buildings wing); Deputy CM Eknath Shinde's notes list PWD including Public Undertakings.

st-mh-dept-finance.name: Finance Department
st-mh-dept-finance.description: Prepares the state budget, manages treasury, government borrowing and expenditure control, and releases funds to every other department.
st-mh-dept-finance.head: st-mh-pos-deputy-cm-2

st-mh-dept-planning.name: Planning Department
st-mh-dept-planning.description: Coordinates the state's five-year and annual plans, District Planning Committees and centrally sponsored scheme funding.
st-mh-dept-planning.head: st-mh-pos-deputy-cm-2

st-mh-dept-state-excise.name: State Excise Department
st-mh-dept-state-excise.description: Regulates manufacture, sale and taxation of liquor in Maharashtra and enforces prohibition rules in dry areas.
st-mh-dept-state-excise.head: st-mh-pos-deputy-cm-2

st-mh-dept-water-resources.name: Water Resources Department
st-mh-dept-water-resources.description: Builds and operates dams, canals and irrigation projects across the state's river valleys.
st-mh-dept-water-resources.head: st-mh-pos-minister-1
st-mh-dept-water-resources.notes: Split by river-valley development corporation: Radhakrishna Vikhe Patil (minister-1) holds the Godavari & Krishna Valley wing; Girish Mahajan (minister-5) holds the Vidarbha, Tapi & Konkan valley wing.

st-mh-dept-revenue.name: Revenue Department
st-mh-dept-revenue.description: Maintains land records, conducts land acquisition, collects non-agricultural land revenue and runs the district collectorate/tehsil administration.
st-mh-dept-revenue.head: st-mh-pos-minister-2

st-mh-dept-medical-education.name: Medical Education and Drugs Department
st-mh-dept-medical-education.description: Runs the state's government medical, dental and nursing colleges and their attached hospitals.
st-mh-dept-medical-education.head: st-mh-pos-minister-3

st-mh-dept-higher-and-technical-educatio.name: Higher and Technical Education Department
st-mh-dept-higher-and-technical-educatio.description: Regulates state universities, engineering/polytechnic colleges and higher-education scholarships.
st-mh-dept-higher-and-technical-educatio.head: st-mh-pos-minister-4

st-mh-dept-parliamentary-affairs.name: Parliamentary Affairs Department
st-mh-dept-parliamentary-affairs.description: Coordinates government business in the Maharashtra Legislative Assembly and Council, including answers to legislature questions.
st-mh-dept-parliamentary-affairs.head: st-mh-pos-minister-4

st-mh-dept-disaster-management.name: Disaster Management Department
st-mh-dept-disaster-management.description: Coordinates flood, drought, fire and other disaster preparedness and response across the state, working with district administrations.
st-mh-dept-disaster-management.head: st-mh-pos-minister-5

st-mh-dept-water-supply-and-sanitation.name: Water Supply and Sanitation Department
st-mh-dept-water-supply-and-sanitation.description: Runs rural piped water-supply schemes and sanitation programmes such as Jal Jeevan Mission implementation in Maharashtra.
st-mh-dept-water-supply-and-sanitation.head: st-mh-pos-minister-6

st-mh-dept-forest.name: Forest Department
st-mh-dept-forest.description: Manages state forests, wildlife sanctuaries and tiger reserves, and enforces forest and wildlife protection laws.
st-mh-dept-forest.head: st-mh-pos-minister-7

st-mh-dept-school-education.name: School Education and Sports Department
st-mh-dept-school-education.description: Runs state government and aided schools, sets the school curriculum and administers school scholarships and mid-day meals.
st-mh-dept-school-education.head: st-mh-pos-minister-8

st-mh-dept-soil-and-water-conservation.name: Soil and Water Conservation Department
st-mh-dept-soil-and-water-conservation.description: Runs watershed development and soil-conservation works to improve rain-fed farmland and groundwater recharge.
st-mh-dept-soil-and-water-conservation.head: st-mh-pos-minister-9

st-mh-dept-food-civil-supplies-and-consu.name: Food, Civil Supplies and Consumer Protection Department
st-mh-dept-food-civil-supplies-and-consu.description: Runs the public distribution system (ration shops), enforces the Essential Commodities Act and handles consumer-protection grievances.
st-mh-dept-food-civil-supplies-and-consu.head: st-mh-pos-minister-10

st-mh-dept-skill-development-and-entrepr.name: Skill Development and Entrepreneurship Department
st-mh-dept-skill-development-and-entrepr.description: Runs ITIs and vocational training programmes and state employment/self-employment schemes for youth.
st-mh-dept-skill-development-and-entrepr.head: st-mh-pos-minister-11

st-mh-dept-industries.name: Industries Department
st-mh-dept-industries.description: Frames industrial policy, runs MIDC industrial estates and administers investment incentives for factories in the state.
st-mh-dept-industries.head: st-mh-pos-minister-12

st-mh-dept-marathi-language.name: Marathi Language Department
st-mh-dept-marathi-language.description: Promotes and standardises the Marathi language, runs the state's Marathi Language Institute and translation work.
st-mh-dept-marathi-language.head: st-mh-pos-minister-12

st-mh-dept-marketing.name: Marketing Department
st-mh-dept-marketing.description: Regulates Agricultural Produce Market Committees (APMCs/mandis) and farm-produce marketing across the state.
st-mh-dept-marketing.head: st-mh-pos-minister-13

st-mh-dept-protocol.name: Protocol Department
st-mh-dept-protocol.description: Arranges state protocol for VIP visits, ceremonial functions and precedence at government events.
st-mh-dept-protocol.head: st-mh-pos-minister-13

st-mh-dept-environment-and-climate-chang.name: Environment and Climate Change Department
st-mh-dept-environment-and-climate-chang.description: Enforces pollution-control rules through the Maharashtra Pollution Control Board and coordinates the state's climate action plan.
st-mh-dept-environment-and-climate-chang.head: st-mh-pos-minister-14

st-mh-dept-animal-husbandry.name: Animal Husbandry Department
st-mh-dept-animal-husbandry.description: Runs veterinary hospitals, livestock development and animal-disease control programmes.
st-mh-dept-animal-husbandry.head: st-mh-pos-minister-14

st-mh-dept-obc-welfare.name: OBC, VJNT and Bahujan Welfare Department
st-mh-dept-obc-welfare.description: Runs welfare hostels, scholarships and reservation implementation for Other Backward Classes and Vimukta Jati/Nomadic Tribes.
st-mh-dept-obc-welfare.head: st-mh-pos-minister-15

st-mh-dept-dairy-development.name: Dairy Development Department
st-mh-dept-dairy-development.description: Runs state dairy cooperatives and milk-procurement schemes to support dairy farmers.
st-mh-dept-dairy-development.head: st-mh-pos-minister-15

st-mh-dept-new-and-renewable-energy.name: New and Renewable Energy Department
st-mh-dept-new-and-renewable-energy.description: Promotes solar, wind and other renewable power projects, separate from the main Energy Department's conventional-power mandate.
st-mh-dept-new-and-renewable-energy.head: st-mh-pos-minister-15

st-mh-dept-tribal-development.name: Tribal Development Department
st-mh-dept-tribal-development.description: Runs welfare hostels, ashram schools and livelihood schemes for Scheduled Tribe communities.
st-mh-dept-tribal-development.head: st-mh-pos-minister-16

st-mh-dept-tourism.name: Tourism Department
st-mh-dept-tourism.description: Promotes tourist destinations, forts and heritage sites and runs the Maharashtra Tourism Development Corporation.
st-mh-dept-tourism.head: st-mh-pos-minister-17

st-mh-dept-mining.name: Mining Department
st-mh-dept-mining.description: Grants mining leases and collects royalty on minor and major minerals extracted in the state.
st-mh-dept-mining.head: st-mh-pos-minister-17

st-mh-dept-ex-servicemen-welfare.name: Ex-Servicemen Welfare Department
st-mh-dept-ex-servicemen-welfare.description: Runs welfare, pension-linked and resettlement schemes for retired armed-forces personnel domiciled in Maharashtra.
st-mh-dept-ex-servicemen-welfare.head: st-mh-pos-minister-17

st-mh-dept-information-technology.name: Information Technology Department
st-mh-dept-information-technology.description: Drives e-governance projects, state data centres and IT/ITeS investment policy.
st-mh-dept-information-technology.head: st-mh-pos-minister-18

st-mh-dept-cultural-affairs.name: Cultural Affairs Department
st-mh-dept-cultural-affairs.description: Runs state cultural festivals, archives, museums and grants to arts and heritage bodies.
st-mh-dept-cultural-affairs.head: st-mh-pos-minister-18

st-mh-dept-women-and-child-development.name: Women and Child Development Department
st-mh-dept-women-and-child-development.description: Runs anganwadis, child nutrition schemes and women's safety and welfare programmes such as one-stop crisis centres.
st-mh-dept-women-and-child-development.head: st-mh-pos-minister-19

st-mh-dept-agriculture.name: Agriculture Department
st-mh-dept-agriculture.description: Runs farm-input subsidy schemes, crop insurance coordination and agricultural extension services for the state's farmers.
st-mh-dept-agriculture.head: st-mh-pos-minister-21

st-mh-dept-rural-development-and-panchay.name: Rural Development and Panchayat Raj Department
st-mh-dept-rural-development-and-panchay.description: Oversees Zilla Parishads, Panchayat Samitis and Gram Panchayats and runs rural livelihood and employment schemes.
st-mh-dept-rural-development-and-panchay.head: st-mh-pos-minister-22

st-mh-dept-food-and-drug-administration.name: Food and Drug Administration Department
st-mh-dept-food-and-drug-administration.description: Licenses and inspects food businesses and drug manufacturers/sellers for safety and quality compliance.
st-mh-dept-food-and-drug-administration.head: st-mh-pos-minister-23

st-mh-dept-textiles.name: Textiles Department
st-mh-dept-textiles.description: Supports the state's cooperative and powerloom textile mills and handloom weavers through subsidy schemes.
st-mh-dept-textiles.head: st-mh-pos-minister-24

st-mh-dept-social-justice-and-special-as.name: Social Justice and Special Assistance Department
st-mh-dept-social-justice-and-special-as.description: Runs welfare hostels, scholarships and atrocity-relief schemes for Scheduled Castes and other socially disadvantaged groups.
st-mh-dept-social-justice-and-special-as.head: st-mh-pos-minister-25

st-mh-dept-transport.name: Transport Department
st-mh-dept-transport.description: Regulates vehicle registration and driving licences through the RTOs and oversees the state road transport corporation (MSRTC).
st-mh-dept-transport.head: st-mh-pos-minister-26

st-mh-dept-employment-guarantee-and-hort.name: Employment Guarantee Scheme and Horticulture Department
st-mh-dept-employment-guarantee-and-hort.description: Runs MGNREGA-linked state employment-guarantee works and horticulture development schemes, including Khar-land (saline coastal land) reclamation.
st-mh-dept-employment-guarantee-and-hort.head: st-mh-pos-minister-27

st-mh-dept-relief-and-rehabilitation.name: Relief and Rehabilitation Department
st-mh-dept-relief-and-rehabilitation.description: Provides drought, flood and calamity relief payouts and resettles people displaced by dam and other public projects.
st-mh-dept-relief-and-rehabilitation.head: st-mh-pos-minister-28

st-mh-dept-fisheries.name: Fisheries Department
st-mh-dept-fisheries.description: Regulates marine and inland fishing and runs welfare schemes for the state's fishing communities.
st-mh-dept-fisheries.head: st-mh-pos-minister-29

st-mh-dept-ports.name: Ports Department
st-mh-dept-ports.description: Develops and regulates Maharashtra's minor ports and coastal shipping infrastructure.
st-mh-dept-ports.head: st-mh-pos-minister-29

st-mh-dept-labour.name: Labour Department
st-mh-dept-labour.description: Enforces labour laws, registers factories/shops and runs the state's labour welfare boards.
